title: OpenCut website and source repository were publicly referenced
summary: On 2026-07-18, a message associated with OpenCut linked both the project website and its GitHub repository. From the dated links alone, this is treated as a material public-facing development record because it directed readers to the project and its source code. The available evidence does not establish whether it marked a launch, release, or feature update.
